theme_and_identity.name: Sethu Clinical Trial Dashboard
theme_and_identity.aesthetic: Clinical & Dense, calm, precise, professional. NO fluff, NO AI hype, NO emojis.
theme_and_identity.density: High density, minimal whitespace, information-rich rows, compact but readable
theme_and_identity.theme_preference: Light mode default for medical/clinical environments (highest contrast, zero glare)

fonts.sans: Inter or IBM Plex Sans (for labels, headings, UI text)
fonts.mono: IBM Plex Mono, Fira Code, or JetBrains Mono (for IDs, scores, dates, source quotes)

hierarchy.mono_quote: font-mono text-xs leading-relaxed bg-muted/50 p-2 rounded-sm border border-border

typography.guidelines: Use monospace strictly for data points (IDs, percentages, scores, dates) and exact source excerpts to convey raw, unmodified truth. Use sans-serif for interface navigation and labels.

fail.pattern: Cross-hatch (use CSS repeating-linear-gradient or SVG background pattern)

grids_layouts.left_pane: w-80 border-r border-slate-200 bg-slate-50 flex flex-col overflow-y-auto (Volunteer Queue)
grids_layouts.right_pane: flex-1 flex flex-col overflow-y-auto bg-white p-6 (Detail View)
grids_layouts.spacing: Tight spacing (p-2, p-3, gap-2). Avoid p-8+ unless separating major contextual regions.
grids_layouts.surfaces: Flat Solid surfaces ONLY. NO Glassmorphism. Medical apps require optical clarity, zero visual refraction.

injection_banner.style: bg-red-600 text-white font-medium p-2 text-sm flex items-center justify-center gap-2
injection_banner.behavior: Top-level, non-dismissible warning if instruction-like text is detected.

volunteer_queue.item_style: p-3 border-b border-border cursor-pointer hover:bg-slate-100 focus:bg-slate-200 focus:outline-none focus:ring-1 inset-ring transition-colors

scoring_display.container: flex items-baseline gap-2 mb-6 pb-4 border-b
scoring_display.prominent: text-2xl font-bold font-mono text-slate-900 (e.g. 'N of 11 cleared')

criteria_strip.row: grid grid-cols-[3rem_auto_1fr] items-start gap-4 p-3 border rounded-md bg-white
criteria_strip.status_badge: w-8 h-8 rounded-sm flex items-center justify-center border
criteria_strip.missing_data: Fail-loud explicit state: 'Cannot resolve: data not available'
criteria_strip.contradiction: Surface both values with timestamps explicitly in a bordered sub-block
criteria_strip.excerpt: mt-2 p-2 bg-slate-50 border border-slate-100 font-mono text-xs text-slate-600

evaluation_footer.layout: fixed bottom-0 left-0 right-0 border-t bg-slate-900 text-slate-300
evaluation_footer.behavior: Collapsible strip. Hidden by default. Quarantines technical metrics (latency, accuracy, gold labels).

actions.accept: bg-emerald-600 hover:bg-emerald-700 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-sm shadow-sm
actions.exclude: bg-white border border-slate-300 text-slate-700 hover:bg-slate-50 font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-sm
actions.rescreen: ml-auto bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white font-medium px-4 py-2 rounded-sm relative overflow-hidden

progress_bar.implementation: Real 30-60s progress bar inside or overlaying the Re-screen button. Strict linear progression UI. No bouncing/pulsing.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Minimal. shadow-sm on primary buttons. The rest is flattened with 1px borders.
visual_enhancers.borders: Sharp edges. Use rounded-sm (2px) or rounded-md (4px) maximum. Never pill-shape unless for small status badges.
visual_enhancers.icons: Lucide-react. Keep stroke-width to 2 for clarity. Do NOT use emojis anywhere.

motion_and_interactions.general: Instantaneous. 0-100ms transitions for hover states to feel responsive and decisive.
motion_and_interactions.progress: Re-screen button uses a steady width transition spanning 30-60 seconds to simulate actual ML pipeline runtime.
motion_and_interactions.focus: Aggressive focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none) for accessibility.

accessibility_and_testing.color_blind_safe: Mandatory use of specific shapes (Check, X, Minus) AND specific background patterns (solid vs cross-hatch) to ensure state is readable without hue.
accessibility_and_testing.keyboard_nav: Full keyboard support required. Left pane must support Up/Down arrow key navigation to switch selected volunteers. Attach onKeyDown to the list container, manage active index in state, and focus management.
accessibility_and_testing.aria: Use aria-live='polite' for the re-screen progress bar and scoring updates.
accessibility_and_testing.data_testid_guidelines: ALL interactive and informational elements MUST have data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='volunteer-item-123', data-testid='accept-btn', data-testid='criteria-c01-status')

instructions_to_main_agent: DO NOT use .tsx. Use .js extensions as requested by the environment structure.
NEVER use generic 'AI' aesthetics (gradients, glassmorphism, sparkles, robot emojis). The theme is strictly 'Clinical & Dense'.
Build Shadcn components exactly to the dense spec, overriding default excessive padding if needed.
Ensure 'Cannot resolve: data not available' is shown prominently for missing criteria, with a distinct grey dash state.
For criteria contradictory data, explicitly show the conflicting records in a red/amber tinted sub-box with 'Record 1 [timestamp]' and 'Record 2 [timestamp]'.
Keep 'Accept' and 'Exclude' actions purely in-memory (update state).
Implement actual arrow key navigation in the left pane: hitting ArrowDown should move the selected patient down and load their data on the right.
DO NOT use a fully transparent header. Always use a solid background for navigation/banners.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Create depth through layering, not excessive shadows (z-index hierarchy).
Never center-align paragraphs, lists, or dense data. Left-align for reading flow.
Do not use AI assistant Emojis.
Use Phosphor icons or lucide-react. Emojis are strictly banned for this clinical UI.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
All forms and interactive UI must include data-testid.
Always apply focus states with higher contrast than the default state.
